## Entry

**Namespace:** `Cyrena.LTM.Models`

**Type:** `public class` (inherits `Entity`)

Represents a memory entry — the searchable envelope that groups related facts. The entry holds metadata (title, description, keywords) for discovery, while the actual things to remember live in `Facts`.

### Constructor

```csharp
public Entry()
```
Initializes with a new ULID and empty facts list.

### Properties

#### `CategoryId`
```csharp
[Required]
public string CategoryId { get; set; } = default!;
```
The category ID this memory belongs to. Required.

#### `Title`
```csharp
[Required]
[MaxLength(100)]
public string Title { get; set; } = default!;
```
Brief title of the memory — the primary human-readable label. Required, max 100 chars.

#### `Keywords`
```csharp
public string[] Keywords { get; set; } = [];
```
Keywords for searching and cross-referencing. Used by `MemoryService.CalculateSearchScore`.

#### `Description`
```csharp
[MaxLength(255)]
public string? Description { get; set; }
```
Brief description providing context. Max 255 chars.

#### `Facts`
```csharp
public List<MemoryFact> Facts { get; set; }
```
Structured facts associated with this memory — the actual things to remember. Each fact has a free-form `FactType` and typed key-value properties. Search scans fact types and property values.

### Usage Example

```csharp
var entry = new Entry
{
    CategoryId = category.Id,
    Title = "User prefers dark mode",
    Description = "Observed during onboarding",
    Keywords = ["theme", "dark mode", "preference", "ui"],
    Facts =
    [
        new MemoryFact
        {
            FactType = "preference",
            ["subject"] = "theme",
            ["value"] = "dark",
            ["confidence"] = "high"
        }
    ]
};
```

### Design Principles

- **Separation of concerns:** Metadata (searchable) vs. Facts (structured data)
- **Searchable metadata:** Title, description, and keywords are the primary search surface
- **Deep search:** `MemoryService` also scans fact types and property values during keyword search
- **Dynamic facts:** The AI invents `FactType` values organically; no fixed schema
